text:
Mae (oncall-release): Kicking off handover for the midnight change window. Targets: API v2.3.0, Runtime kernel batching switch, Console UI toggle behind flag, Router KV eviction config. Need sequencing, pin versions, and rollback plan. @ryan @lina

deploy-bot: Deploy bot scheduled for 2026-03-22 00:00-01:00 UTC. Canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Auto-rollback triggers: increased 5xx rate or p99 latency spike threshold. Plan created but not started.

ryan: my suggested order: runtime -> api -> router -> console. runtime needs kernel pin to kernel-1.2.0. If runtime fails we must stop the rest.

lina: I'd prefer api before router so we can validate header behavior at the edge. API change adds optional header `x-rd-cache` only used when router supports new eviction header.

jess: console flag is behind `ff:release/routing-header` — I can hold flipping until router/runtime green.

ryan: router change includes TTL bump and kv-eviction tweak. plan for router: 2-pod canary, monitor cache_miss_rate and 95th percentile response time.

Mae (oncall-release): Proposed sequence: 1) runtime (kernel-1.2.0 pin) canary 5% 15m 2) api v2.3.0 canary 5% 10m 3) router config canary 5% 10m 4) console ff flip 10% -> 100%. Rollback criteria: >3% errors OR p99 latency +40% from baseline at any step -> stop and revert previous change. ack?

ops-bot: Reminder: SLOs to watch: p99 latency <= 300ms, error rate <= 0.5%. Alerts: #incidents if breached.

ryan: add specific runtime fallback: if kernel change causes regressions, rollback runtime and route to fallback model variant `gpt-mini-stable` for affected API traffic via routing-policy temporary pin.

lina: we'll need a small release-note blurb for API: mention `x-rd-cache` optional header and fallback compatibility. I'll draft.

Mae (oncall-release): Jess — can you hold the console flip until `cache_miss_rate` < 0.05 for 10m after router canary?

jess: yes, I'll gate the flag flip.

Mae (oncall-release): Adding emergency rollback snippet to runbook:
```
# rollback runtime
kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime --to-revision=stable
# revert router config
kubectl apply -f router-config-stable.yaml
# abort deploy plan
/deploy abort 202603220000
```

deploy-bot: Deploy plan saved as id 202603220000. Use `/deploy start 202603220000` to execute.

ryan: LGTM. I'll be on-call and watching runtime metrics during the window.

lina: I'll monitor `cache_miss_rate` and p99; will post updates in this thread.

Mae (oncall-release): I'll author the release notes + changelog and pin PRs for kernel-1.2.0 + api v2.3.0 + router-config v1.8. Marking this thread as the coordination anchor for the window. Final ack?

ryan: ack

jess: ack

lina: ack

Mae (oncall-release): thanks all — will call deploy when ready.
